title: Helpdesk Ticket #CS-241195 — Zone 1 Homeowner: Water Taste Normal, Asking if Safe to Drink

fields.subject: Water taste has returned to normal — is it safe to drink now?
fields.description:
The water just turned clear and tasteless — is it safe to drink now?

12 calls in 3 minutes from Zone 1 residents reporting the same: 'It's not lye anymore, it's just water.'

All say: 'We haven't flushed yet. Should we drink it now?'

activity.author: Customer Service Lead
activity.text: High-volume inbound. 12 calls in 3 minutes from Zone 1 residents reporting water has returned to normal. All ask: 'Is it safe to drink now?'

activity.author: Customer Service Lead
activity.text: This is a public trust pressure point. The advisory remains in effect. No lift has been confirmed. Instruct staff to hold the line and use the approved script: 'The advisory remains in effect until confirmed by the City. Do not drink tap water until further notice.'

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

instructorNote: Pressure inject; the public is beginning to self-assess and act on perceived recovery. The PIO must confirm that no advisory has been lifted and reinforce the official stance to prevent premature use.
